summary.text: Lisa White is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 96, listed with Berkeley County. Her legislative page lists committee assignments on Education, Educational Choice and Higher Education.

paragraphs.text: White's page gives her birth date as March 7, 1959, and lists her education as high school and her occupation as retired.
It names her spouse as William, lists two children, Erin and Shelby, and names her parents as Stanley and Ruby Ketchel.
Her affiliations include the Berkeley County Republican Club and Covenant Church.
